title: The Command to Build
art: No figure appears in the revelation: only light and the words. Nuh is a small figure of light seen from behind; the outline of the ship is a symbol of the command, not a drawing of the ark's true shape.
imagePrompt: Night on a hill above a sleeping town, a vast star-filled sky painted in deep indigo ink-wash; seen from behind, a small figure of white-gold light kneels alone on the hilltop with head lowered; a soft, wide light descends over him from above, and white-gold Arabic calligraphy writes itself across the whole night sky in brush strokes; within the calligraphy faint ink lines sketch the outline of a great ship like a plan drawn on parchment, then fade; indigo night, silver stars, white-gold calligraphy, parchment texture, no faces.

beats.say: At night, Nuh knelt alone on the hill above the sleeping town.
A soft light came down over him, and words filled the night sky.

verse.en: And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed…
And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration…
